text: Heaven also sent a great crow, Yatagarasu, which guided the army through wild mountains all the way to Yamato.
spoken: Heaven also sent a great crow, Yahtahgahrahsoo, which guided the army through wild mountains all the way to Yahmahtoh.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, po nazwie, długie słowo (5 syl.)
